prompts.title: Q: Is ATT&CK a compliance framework?
Q: How would you measure detection coverage?
prompts.answerMarkdown: **A:** **Navigator** **layer** of **implemented** **rules** per **technique**, weighted by **asset** **criticality**, with **explicit** **notes** on **procedure** **gaps** and **false** **negative** **postmortems**.

prompts.title: Q: CVE-XXXX maps to which technique?
prompts.answerMarkdown:
**A:** **Careful**-**CVEs** are **vulns**; **exploitation** **might** support **Execution** or **Initial** **Access** depending on **context**. **Avoid** **over**-**specific** **mapping** without **analysis**.
